item.title: list_pickable_ids sorts within each backlog file independently — must bugs appear after should feats
item.intent: list_pickable_ids must return all pickable IDs in a single globally-sorted list so must-priority bugs are always listed before should-priority features regardless of which file they come from.
item.description: list_pickable_ids calls _list_pickable_one via map_backlog_files, which sorts items per-file and emits them. The outputs are concatenated in BACKLOG_FILES order (backlog.json first, then bugs.json). A 'should' feature in backlog.json therefore appears before a 'must' bug in bugs.json in the queued_ids array used by auto sessions. This causes the displayed queue order in session headers to misrepresent priority, and could cause issues if this list is ever used for selection.
steps: Change _list_pickable_one to collect items into a shared array instead of printing sorted per-file
After map_backlog_files completes, sort the combined list globally by priority (must=0, should=1, could=2) and print IDs
Alternative: collect all items via jq --slurp across files, then sort once
Run shellcheck — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: When backlog.json has a should item and bugs.json has a must item, list_pickable_ids returns the must item first
Existing single-file sort order is preserved
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
